ingredients.role: main wall body / masonry infill of nave and tower
ingredients.rationale: Irregular rounded-pebble texture with random grey cobbles of mixed light/dark value and no straight mortar courses — the signature cobblestone face, not the regular rectangular brick grid.

ingredients.role: quoins/corners, window surrounds, eaves & gable verge course, and base plinth
ingredients.rationale: Clean regular rectangular blocks with even straight mortar seams framing every corner, the window jambs, the roof-line stringcourse and the ground course — the orderly stone_bricks grid contrasting deliberately against the rough cobblestone field.
Warm medium-brown boards with long straight horizontal plank seams and a flat even grain running down the pitch — the smooth dark-brown spruce plank face rather than the streaky dark_oak grain.

ingredients.role: stepped pyramidal tower roof and the eave/verge course of the main roof
ingredients.rationale: The tower cap is built of receding tiers each stepping inward and the roof edges show a stepped overhanging lip — the right-angle profile of stacked stairs, matching the same brown plank wood.

ingredients.role: tower entrance door at the base
ingredients.rationale: A two-tall brown wooden panel set into the tower's stone-brick surround at ground level with visible vertical plank divisions — a wooden door leaf, matching the spruce roof wood.

unidentified.surface: tall narrow window slits in band0 (nave and tower)
unidentified.reason: The apertures read as solid dark recesses with no visible infill material (no bars, glass mullions, or shutter grain) — they appear to be empty shadowed openings, so I cannot honestly name a block placed in them.
